entries.message: indexed access on a secret value: 'aura' derives from C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex(), secret in 12.1 while auras are secret (combat, encounters, M+, PvP); show auras with an AuraContainer (AddAuraGroup/AddAuraSlot) instead

C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex() reaches aura data by index, slot or instance id, which Lua errors while auras are secret (combat, encounters, M+, PvP); show auras with an AuraContainer (AddAuraGroup/AddAuraSlot) instead
indexed access on a secret value: 'coords' derives from UnitClass(), whose returns are secret in 12.1 while the unit's identity is secret
